How v1 scored

Test setPhotosCorrect
Mock bucket, clear88 / 8
Mock bucket, blocked (unseen leaf layout)88 / 8
Real Brick Hill buckets20 / 2

Trained in Teachable Machine on 37 frames from two home videos: 17 clear and 20 blocked. Blocked means more than half of the water is hidden.

What it gets wrong, and why

  • It calls both real Brick Hill photos blocked with over 95% confidence, even though most of the water is visible.
  • It learned what our mock bucket looks like: blue plastic, greenish water, a wooden floor. Real buckets are white, the water is dark brown, and the photos include a tape measure, a sign and strong sky reflections. This is called domain shift.
  • The mock test frames come from the same videos as the training frames, so 100% there is optimistic.
  • Next: train on photos from the real cameras once they are installed on the hill.
Model v1, trained 26 Oct 2026. Runs entirely in your browser; photos are not uploaded anywhere.
